about: Hand review of playbook_draft.json (local-AI tags) for floors 1-4 enemies that have no hand-checked enemy_playbook.json entry. Each entry overrides the listed fields of the draft; 'ok' = draft checked and kept as is. Applied when the drafts are merged into the playbook (step 4). Reviewed against the wiki text in wiki_bestiary.json, 2026-11-25.

227.1.how: Throws 3 bones in a row when it sees Isaac: break line of sight or sidestep; it explodes on death, so don't finish it up close.

236.0.how: Invulnerable; pulls Isaac, tears and shots toward it every few seconds: stay well away and don't shoot it.

240.1.how: Crawls along the wall to line up with Isaac, then fires a stream: don't stand straight out from it; shoot it from an angle.

240.3.how: Crawls the walls and fires 4 diagonal streams: never stand on its diagonals.

244.2.how: Pops up with several tail ends; the head's big shot splits into 8: keep far from the head when it surfaces and keep moving.

244.3.how: Pops up and lobs 4 explosive shots at Isaac: move off the landing spots, shoot it while it's up.

267.0.unsure: boss: wiki entry had no behaviour text in the parse; tags unchecked

804.0.how: Invulnerable; jumps and fires a line of rocks in one direction on landing: stay off the line it faces.

809.0.how: Invulnerable; coughs up a throwable bomb: keep 100+ px from the bomb.

817.1.how: Runs from Isaac and spawns Willos when he gets close: shoot it from range; 1-2 Willos come out when it dies.

818.2.how: Fast crawler that rushes Isaac on sight; it leaves a hot coal that hurts on touch and blocks shots: shoot it early, then walk around the coal.

820.1.how: Spits hot coals (some become Coal Spiders): keep distance, kill it early.

827.1.how: Calm until hurt; then chases and fires 6-shot rings often: finish it fast once you start, from range.

844.0.how: Spits a Giga Bomb and runs from it: get far from the bomb (big blast), kill it before it spits.

855.1.how: Once it sees Isaac it keeps charging along the nearest row or column: stay diagonal to it and shoot.

882.0.how: Only visible up close and speeds up once seen; teleports away when hurt: keep distance and shoot when it shows.

202.10.how: Invulnerable; fires 4 ways, switching between straight and diagonal: stand between its lines and keep moving.

212.4.how: Drifts diagonally and makes a ring of fire when Isaac gets close: keep 100+ px away; dies when the room is cleared.

22.3.how: Runs from Isaac and spawns 6 flies when he gets close; lots of flies on death: shoot it from range, be ready for the swarm.

23.3.how: Charges when Isaac lines up DIAGONALLY with it (not on rows/columns); only its tail can be hurt: stay off its diagonals, shoot the tail.

25.3.how: Flies in diagonal lines; on death it leaves 4 long fire lines along its row and column: step off them when it dies.

25.4.how: Flies diagonally; shoots bones when Isaac lines up on its row or column; 3 bones on death: stay diagonal to it.

25.6.how: On death it glows, then explosions run along its whole row and column: kill it, then get off both lines at once.

29.3.how: Jumps and twirls, firing growing rings: keep distance so the ring gaps are wide.

39.2.how: Fires a tethered, invulnerable Charger at Isaac when he's in its line of sight (blocks tears, flies back): break line of sight, shoot the Chubber from an angle.

41.2.how: Shielded in front; rushes Isaac when it sees him: sidestep and shoot it from the side or back.

42.2.how: Invulnerable; fires a triple shot now and then until the room is clear: sidestep it, don't shoot it.

87.1.how: Spits fireballs that make fire lines along the row and column where they land: keep away from the impact spot's lines.

93.0.how: The Mask can't be hurt and charges when Isaac lines up: stay off its row and column, kill its Heart (it dies with it).
